capabilities: Search books across multiple providers by title or ISBN13
Create book notes from templates with customizable frontmatter and cover images
Update book info and abstract sections in existing notes
Detect duplicate notes vault-wide by ISBN13 before creation
Track reading status with wishlist/reading/read commands and date stamping
disambiguation: Despite the name, search is only the input; the plugin's job is creating and maintaining book notes in the vault, not just looking books up.
extras: Generated notes carry a mandatory YES24 attribution footer with no toggle when YES24 data is used; the Aladin OpenAPI shuts down 2026-10-30 and its code is removed in v2.0.0, which also ends the used-book price check feature with no replacement; full changelog lives in CHANGELOG.md rather than the README.
motivation: Built to solve the Naver Book Search API end-of-life (2026-08-01) and provide a proper Korean-first book note workflow after the predecessor plugin became unmaintained.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search external book databases and generate book notes, and the main Korean source lost its API.

relations.evidence: If you already hold a working TTB Key, the Aladin provider keeps functioning until the shutdown date

summary: Book note maker that metasearches YES24, Kakao, Google Books, and Open Library and creates templated notes with frontmatter, covers, and reading status.
